history.summary: A 980sqft 2BR at $1.30M / $1,327 PSF near Serangoon (NEX, NE12) priced ~5% below the $1,398 URA median, in a 24-year-old leasehold development. Solid value entry with a low absolute price band, but the 7.95% CAGR rests on only 26 transactions and lease decay is now a real headwind at 24 years.
history.rating_rationale: Priced below district median ($1,327 vs $1,398) and in the liquid sub-$1.5M band that HDB upgraders favour, with NEX/Serangoon connectivity supporting tenant demand. But the 7.95% appreciation is built on a thin 26-txn series (unreliable), the 99yr lease from a 2002 build leaves ~75yr and decay accelerates from here, and the 980sqft generous size means PSF is not as cheap as it looks per-unit.
red_flags: Appreciation rate from only 26 URA transactions — low confidence
740m to MRT is a moderate, not prime, walk
catalysts: ~5% below URA median PSF leaves room
NEX mega-mall and Serangoon interchange (NEL+CCL) anchor tenant/buyer demand
Sub-$1.5M price keeps buyer pool deep

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR near a major interchange and NEX retail hub has a broad tenant pool; yield likely in the 3.3-3.7% range typical for the band.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Headline 7.95% is overstated by a thin sample; a 4-5% forward rate is more defensible for a maturing leasehold trading near district median.
